name: Appbot App Reviews
description:
Appbot has analysed App Store and Google Play reviews for over a decade, across every category and language. The AI behind this connector is trained on our corpus of 400M+ real reviews.

Connect your App Store and Google Play apps, and Claude queries your review data directly instead of working from raw text:

What is driving negative reviews this month?
Which feature requests have grown over the last 90 days?
Why are iOS ratings lower than Android?
How has sentiment shifted since our latest release?
How does our sentiment compare to a competitor's?

Competitor apps work the same way, so you can benchmark sentiment and feature gaps against anyone in your category.

Each team member connects with their own Appbot credentials, so Claude only sees what that person can already see in Appbot.

MCP access is included on Appbot's Large and Premium plans.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Appbot App Reviews to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Appbot App Reviews to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.appbot.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Appbot App Reviews MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appbot App Reviews provides these MCP tools: apps_tool, review_stats_tool, and reviews_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Appbot App Reviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Appbot App Reviews in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Appbot App Reviews MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appbot App Reviews requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Appbot App Reviews is developed by Appbot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
